dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you settling in okay?

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: The environs here are most comfortable. The air is pure and peaceful, free of taint or pollution.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: I am certain that your honest spirit was what allowed such an abode to be made manifest.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wait, that matters?

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: But of course. All things here are fashioned from your every thought. As your thoughts fly, so shall they be.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Couldn't we use this as a mood detector, then...?

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Indeed, you are most discerning. That assessment is correct.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: But should you wish to use this as a way to control your thoughts and avoid treading the path of evil, that seems too...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Rigid?

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Mortal hearts are filled with thoughts beyond count, complex and cluttered...

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: "Rage" may drive people to commit acts of violence, yet may also imbue them with courage.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Unpleasant though "Envy" may sound, so too may it push people to strive harder.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: "Fear" is despised by all, yet should one so utterly lack it that they pursue only their own pleasure in all things, without regard for right or wrong, how would they be any different from a base beast?

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Such emotions whisper evil into mortal hearts, yet they can also guide them towards good. The same holds true for the sword in your hand. You choose whether it shall be used to ward off evil or scourge the innocent.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Hehe... But I imagine one such as yourself must have long learned how to control your thoughts.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I can't always control them...

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Oh? And when can you not?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Right now. I'm getting a bit sleepy listening...

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Hahaha. Apologies, 'twas I who spoke too much. I was for many years a teacher, and could not help but launch into a lecture.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: I shall steep a pot of tea. Let us enjoy it together and refresh ourselves.
